source.source_classification: pinned published-equation transcription NOT authentic installed Gymnasium

hypothesis: Can the existing token-free factual SSM/Attention/TTT/depth readout execute a genuinely delayed-goal motor policy after equally supervised expert action imitation, attaining >=95% of strong handcoded momentum controller's goal success and mean net reward on NEW physical resets, without future-outcome leakage? Compare independently trained MLP and GRU to prevent architectural overclaim.

arms.teacher: Existing original P58 conventional bang-bang velocity sign threshold, with first reset action negative; expert produces ONLY executed actual action/next/reward transitions
arms.candidate: unchanged parent model.HybridPilot(input_dim=5,output_dim=1,Configuration(width=8,heads=2,ssm=True,attention=True,ttt=True,depth=True)) on a four-fact-plus-current-query analog sequence; teacher labels used for supervised BCE loss, no source oracle at inference
arms.conventional_GRU: torch.nn.GRU on same sequence and current analog query; hidden width auto-selected before source-use for parameter budget within 10% of candidate; same BCE/AdamW updates/data/minibatches
arms.conventional_MLP: same flattened actual factual history/current query, 2-hidden-layer torch MLP hidden width auto-selected for <=10% candidate param budget; same BCE/AdamW updates/data/minibatches
arms.negative: untrained weights per model seed; report goal success and reward as zero-shot sanity, no claim of science gain

factual_input.query: Current real sensor [position,velocity] plus zero delta and action; last four real pre-sensors+delta+motor action recorded only AFTER official published physical step
factual_input.teacher_labels: Demonstration labels from actual expert current-state action, explicitly imitation and NOT genuine reward-only causal exploration
factual_input.closed_loop: At each future physical step learned policy independently chooses actual +/-1 motor command, publisher advances the actual state, no teacher access

training.loss: binary cross entropy on expert signed action
training.training_data: All actual expert state-action and factual history observations from 128 train resets; no test/validation gradient updates
training.validation: 32 distinct resets, actual closed-loop returns and teacher labels only for training-free classification diagnostics
training.train_minibatches: same index minibatch sequence across models per seed; with-replacement, do not claim equal compute
training.convergence: last two heldout expert-action classification checks differ <=1 percentage point; otherwise convergence unverified

required_each_of_three_seeds: candidate validation closed-loop goal successes >= 95% of handcoded momentum
candidate OOD closed-loop goal successes >= 95% of handcoded momentum
candidate OOD mean physical net reward >= momentum OOD mean reward-5.0
candidate goal success no more than 5 percentage points below BOTH trained conventional MLP and GRU
candidate cold weight restore gives identical signed actions for same factual query
all models use identical actual teacher FIT records and optimizer update count
negative_controls: untrained goal success reported; no generic Hybrid improvement claim
no model gets future reward or teacher rule in closed-loop
same frozen OOD resets for teacher, MLP, GRU and Hybrid, natural termination counts disclosed
frozen_scientific_dev_gate.success_interpretation: DEV readout qualification only: expert imitation does not demonstrate autonomous action-consequence discovery, benefit from TTT fast weights, causal transfer, RSI, scientific pass or official Gymnasium runtime parity
frozen_scientific_dev_gate.total_system_compute: measure individual training+full closed-loop wall and model parameter counts; do not claim compute match without measured active FLOP parity
